hooks.name: parser-tests-on-save
hooks.description: Run unit + property tests whenever the parser, copybook compiler, reconciler or a sample copybook changes. Keeps the deterministic core honest while the agent edits.

action.command: npx vitest run test/unit test/pbt --reporter=dot 2>&1 | tail -20; node scripts/log-hook.mjs PostFileSave "unit+pbt tests ran"

hooks.name: verify-after-agent-stop
hooks.description: Re-derive the newest report in out/ with the real CLI entry (src/cli/main.ts verify) and compare fingerprints; a drift or a missing run is printed into the session instead of being swallowed.

hooks.name: append-evidence-on-task
hooks.description: Append one line to EVIDENCE.md when a spec task completes, so the build record is produced by the workflow rather than written up afterwards. Also records the firing in out/hook-log.txt, so one file holds every hook that ran.

action.command: node scripts/append-evidence.mjs && node scripts/log-hook.mjs PostTaskExec "evidence row appended"
